QUIC tile context, metrics, and runtime state definitions.

# Purpose
This header file defines the `fd_quic_ctx_t` context used by a QUIC processing tile. It includes the external interfaces and data needed for packet reassembly, time tracking, QUIC transmit handling, TLS key material, network input bounds, output workspace state, and key log output. The `metrics` substructure stores counters for received transactions, fragment handling, reassembly state, and packet size errors. The file also declares `fd_tile_quic`, which identifies the tile run function used by the topology system.
